en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's study
I want to scream really loud!
Let's read a picture book

...You're surprisingly diligent.
Are you going to study detective cases?

Then, I think I'll join you on that and
read it with you.

It'll be the perfect time to learn about
detective work. I want to hear it from you.
...Why? I don't understand.

You're not a small kid anymore, so don't
say weird things like that.

Or what?
Am I bothering you or something?
If so, then tell me already.

Is this...because I used to read to the
children back at the orphanage?
You really are...
No, I think...this is good...

You're like this to other people as well...
You should just say whatever's on your mind.

Because there are probably people who
will take it the wrong way...
<CLT=cltMIND>The wrong way...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Maki's inner thoughts...?
